basic_info.description: A tradition of excellence and an architectural master-class in optimal spacial living is showcased here at 653 Fell Street.  EAG Studios brings a perfect open floor plan to you. It is absolutely delicious and so are all the restaurants in Hayes Valley just outside your door. This has to be one of the hottest and most thriving neighborhoods in San Francisco.  Behind the fascade of a gorgeous San Francisco Victorian is brand new construction where no expense was spared.  All Bosch appliances and high end fixtures abound in this two level with 3 Bedrooms or 2 Bedrooms plus office.  The main living floor is superb, it has the great room with high ceilings and huge island-bar seating with plenty of space for living and dining. In addition, there is a large sun drenched deck. Brand new and ready to move in with gorgeous new garage. Direct access into garage from the unit.  2-Unit Building for Condo Conversion fast track.
